branch_provenance.statement: The TT branch is the exact first six generated IDs from full-TT seed 44; the HF branch is the exact first six generated IDs from pinned HF seed 44.

capture.summaries: Top32/ranks/raw full-vocabulary softmax, top-k20-only distribution, and separate host-proxy nominal HF top_p=0.95 and BF16-rounded top_p=0.94921875 nucleus distributions; selected target IDs [138,147,1390,107,556,172109].

comparison: Saved-logit comparison reports PCC/error, raw-softmax TV, top-20 support overlap, and distinct strict-top-k20 and nucleus TVs at nominal p=0.95 and BF16-scalar p=0.94921875. These support/probability metrics are host proxies, not exact HF or device support.
interpretation_limits: Forced-history logits do not establish native branch incidence or equal random streams.
The TT path uses generator.generate(next_input=..., host_sampling=True, buffered=False). It does not reveal the device sampler draw or full internal candidate mapping; it is not a sampler trace.
The existing prefill function still executes its ordinary device-sampler operation; its sampled token is discarded. Subsequent model replay logits are forced through the callback.
No implementation defect, causal bug, answer quality, or performance conclusion is claimed.
Strict top-k20/nucleus supports and probabilities are deterministic host proxies; HF may keep every tie at the kth logit and device support is not exposed. Raw logits and ranks are primary evidence.
